scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.build:worky: pnpm run validate:artifact-config && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-client-react run build
scripts.validate:artifact-config: pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts test && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx src/validate-artifact-config.ts
scripts.validate:worky: pnpm run validate:artifact-config && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-client-react run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:privacy && pnpm --filter @workspace/worky run validate
